biography.value: Mountain Lords have Tremorsense at 300 feet — nothing approaches on the ground without their awareness. Seismic Slam resets the battlefield on arrival. Earth Breaker at Margin 3 drives targets into the ground and begins Engulfing them. Seismic Hurl's radius means groups of enemies cannot cluster in ranged positions without taking area damage. A summoner who gives one a position to hold and a target priority list will find it requires no further management.

system.attacksNotes:
Earth Breaker [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 5 + Melee Combat 6), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 16 damage (10 + 6 Str)
  • Margin 2: 16 damage, DR halved (round up); target Grappled + Prone + Stunned until end of their next turn; no save; ongoing 12 bludgeoning damage per round while Grappled.
  • Margin 3: 16 damage, DR halved (round up) + Grappled + Prone + Stunned; ongoing increases to 18; target begins being driven into the ground — Engulf triggers at start of their next turn unless they succeed Fortitude [Hard] save.

Seismic Hurl [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 5), Range: 80/160 ft, 10-foot diameter.

  • Margin 1:: 16 bludgeoning damage (13 + 3 Dex) + Prone.
  • Margin 2: 16 bludgeoning damage, DR halved (round up) + Prone + Stunned until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 3: 16 bludgeoning damage, DR halved (round up) + Prone + Stunned; all creatures within 10 feet of impact take 8 bludgeoning damage from shockwave.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes:
Immovable: Cannot be knocked Prone by non-magical forced movement. Shoves or Magical movement fail unless the attacker wins an opposed Strength + Might [Hard] check. Earth Bond: While on natural earth or stone, regains 8 HP at the start of its turn. Suppressed if it took magical damage this round. Powerful Build: Rockborn counts as Huge for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Stone Grip: Creatures Grappled by the Mountain Lord add 3 to both dice on Athletics, Acrobatics, and Might checks to escape. Seismic Slam (Recharge 5-8) [Combat]: Slams both fists into the ground simultaneously. All creatures within 30 feet on natural ground make a Reflex save. Compare Str 8 + Might 7 targeting vs. each save. Designated allies immune.

  • Margin 1:: 20 bludgeoning damage + Prone.
  • Margin 2: 20 bludgeoning damage, DR halved (round up) + Prone + Restrained for 1 minute.
  • Margin 3: 20 bludgeoning damage, DR halved (round up) + Prone + Restrained + Stunned until end of their next turn.

Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
system.reactionsNotes: Stone Skin [Reaction]: Once per round, reduce incoming physical damage by 10. Resilient Defense (2/day): When the Mountain Lord fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead.
